title: Saint Louis University to Host Event Honoring UCA Martyrs of El Salvador
summary_en: Saint Louis University, in collaboration with the Immigration Task Force of the Archdiocese of St. Louis, the Central and Southern Province of the Society of Jesus and St. Francis Xavier College Church, will host “What is a Jesuit University For? Remembering the UCA Martyrs of El Salvador.”
